## What changed in Patch 13.10

Agent, map and ranked changes from this patch. Each changed agent is tagged in the tier list below; hover a tag to see the change.

NEUTRAL**Cypher**: Spycam destroy cooldown 60s -> 45s; reclaim cooldown 15s -> 20s

BUFF**Killjoy**: Turret destroy cooldown 60s -> 45s

BUFF**Vyse**: Arc Rose destroy cooldown 60s -> 45s

BUFF**Sage**: Healing Orb targeting accuracy improved; crosshair now visible

REWORK**Assists**: Damage assist now triggers on 10+ dmg within 3s; heal assist window changed

NEW**Gauntlet: Glitched**: New abilities, glitches, Hush ultimate, 5-player queue added

NEW**Replay Bookmarking**: Players can now bookmark moments in replays for easy navigation
